events.title_en: Gift to the Future at Southbank Centre
events.title_it: Gift to the Future al Southbank Centre
events.summary_en: More than 90 lines written with thousands of school pupils turn the Southbank Centre’s brutalist exterior into a site-wide poetry installation inspired by the 1951 Festival of Britain.
events.summary_it: Oltre 90 versi creati con migliaia di studenti trasformano gli edifici brutalisti del Southbank Centre in un’installazione poetica ispirata al Festival of Britain del 1951.

advanced.reason: A temporary intervention connects children’s voices, brutalist architecture and the Festival of Britain legacy across a major public site.

events.title_en: Sacred Treasures from Kyiv at the V&A
events.title_it: Sacred Treasures from Kyiv al V&A
events.summary_en: Seven Ukrainian Baroque sacred works from the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra are shown in the UK for the first time, including an icon, altar Gospel and silver chalice.
events.summary_it: Sette opere sacre del barocco ucraino dalla Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra arrivano per la prima volta nel Regno Unito, tra cui un’icona, un Vangelo da altare e un calice d’argento.

advanced.reason: A rare first UK display that connects Ukrainian religious heritage, Baroque craft and cultural preservation at no cost.

events.summary_en: A darkened, site-specific environment brings together lyrical films on decolonisation, displacement and Partition, including the premiere of the seven-screen work The Charcoal Man.
events.summary_it: Un ambiente immersivo e oscurato riunisce film lirici su decolonizzazione, migrazione e Partizione, inclusa la prima dell’opera a sette schermi The Charcoal Man.

venue.name: Serpentine North Gallery
venue.address: West Carriage Drive, Kensington Gardens, London

advanced.reason: A substantial free moving-image installation uses an unusual gallery environment to explore powerful histories of place, violence and memory.

events.title_en: Japanese Women Photographers: From 1950s to Now
events.title_it: Fotografe giapponesi: dagli anni Cinquanta a oggi
events.summary_en: The final weekend brings together more than 200 photographs, videos, installations and rare books by 27 women whose work challenges a male-dominated account of Japanese photography.
events.summary_it: L’ultimo weekend riunisce oltre 200 fotografie, video, installazioni e libri rari di 27 autrici che riscrivono una storia della fotografia giapponese dominata dagli uomini.

advanced.reason: A major corrective to photographic history, with 27 artists and more than 200 works available for £10 on its final weekend.

events.title_en: Drawn into Your Presence in Clapham
events.title_it: Drawn into Your Presence a Clapham
events.summary_en: A local photographer pairs 30 enlarged Victorian Bible engravings with 30 contemporary images of south London church life inside a Grade II-listed post-war church.
events.summary_it: Un fotografo locale abbina 30 incisioni bibliche vittoriane ingrandite a 30 immagini della vita religiosa nel sud di Londra, in una chiesa modernista di Grade II.

advanced.reason: A one-month local exhibition connects Victorian print culture, south London social history and access to a notable post-war church.

events.summary_en: More than 70 artists trace China’s living craft heritage through ceramics, glass, textiles, jewellery, furniture and immersive digital work in the South Wing galleries.
events.summary_it: Oltre 70 artisti raccontano il patrimonio artigianale cinese attraverso ceramica, vetro, tessuti, gioielli, arredi e opere digitali immersive nelle gallerie South Wing.

venue.name: Somerset House, Embankment Galleries South Wing

advanced.reason: A substantial free exhibition links living craft traditions with contemporary and immersive design in a distinctive London setting.

events.title_en: Woolmen Sheep Drive and Livery Fair
events.title_it: Woolmen Sheep Drive e Livery Fair
events.summary_en: Freemen revive their ancient right to drive sheep over the Thames while the public explores livery trades, wool crafts, blade shearing and rare breeds beside Southwark Bridge.
events.summary_it: I Freemen rievocano l’antico diritto di condurre pecore sul Tamigi, mentre il pubblico scopre corporazioni, artigianato della lana, tosatura e razze rare presso Southwark Bridge.

venue.name: Southwark Bridge and Woolmen Livery Fair
venue.address: Queen Street and Queen Street Place, London

advanced.reason: An exceptionally London-specific livery tradition combines an ancient City right, a one-day spectacle and free public access.

events.title_it: Festa del raccolto al Brixton Windmill
events.summary_en: Inner London’s only working windmill celebrates the wheat harvest with milling demonstrations, baking and craft workshops, hand querns, Morris dancing and local live music.
events.summary_it: L’unico mulino a vento funzionante dell’Inner London celebra il raccolto con dimostrazioni di macinazione, laboratori, macine manuali, Morris dance e musica locale.

advanced.reason: A free neighbourhood celebration offers working-mill demonstrations, local history and traditional harvest activities at a rare London landmark.
